metadata.title: Integrated Health Sector Action Plan: Economic Stability Strategies, July 2026-December 2028
metadata.preparedFor: Black Hawk County Public Health and Advancing Together in the Cedar Valley
metadata.shortPurpose: Coordinate shared cancer prevention, screening, navigation, and barrier-reduction work across Health Sector partners.
metadata.purpose: This charter-style action plan combines Health Sector Objectives 1-3 into one coordinated 2.5-year plan. For this CHIP cycle, Q1 begins July 1, 2026. The plan focuses on shared cancer prevention and screening communication, beginning with breast and prostate cancer awareness and connecting messaging to tobacco cessation, radon testing, vaccination, screening, navigation, transportation, financial assistance, and follow-up care.
metadata.coalitionRole: Advancing Together and the Health Sector partners convene, align, support, and track this work while implementation remains distributed across health and community-resource partners.

objectives.title: Objective 1: Prevention/Risk Factor Reduction
objectives.outcome: By December 31, 2028, at least 5 community organizations partner to implement or expand prevention/risk reduction strategies in areas with higher cancer or chronic disease burden.

objectives.title: Objective 2: Early Detection and Screening
objectives.outcome: By December 31, 2028, at least 3 collaborative outreach and barrier-reduction strategies support participation in age- and risk-appropriate screenings.

objectives.title: Objective 3: Barriers to Care
objectives.outcome: By December 31, 2028, a community-wide collaboration system supports updated resource directories, referral/case-management awareness, more aligned intake where feasible, and cross-sector relationship-building and training.

objectives.title: Integrated/Overlap Actions
objectives.outcome: Cross-objective actions that support prevention, screening, navigation, barrier reduction, reporting, or sustainability.

sections.title: Foundation and scope-setting
sections.summary: Launch the core team, confirm the charter, and use local data to lock the first-year focus.

approve combined Objectives 1-3 scope
